[USER] User inquired about access to clean water in developing countries.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] There are several initiatives and organizations working towards ensuring access to clean water in developing countries, including:  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 1. Water.org: Partners with local microfinance institutions to provide loans for water and sanitation systems.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 2. UNICEF: Implements programs for clean water and improved sanitation.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 3. World Vision: Implements community-based water management programs.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 4. WaterAid: Aims to improve access to safe water, hygiene, and sanitation.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 5. The Global Water Partnership: Supports countries in developing water policies.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 6. USAID: Provides assistance for clean drinking water and sanitation facilities.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] These initiatives lead to improved health outcomes, reduced poverty, and increased economic growth.

[ASSISTANT_SAID] 3. Central and South America: Bolivia, Guatemala, Peru.
